messages:
Samantha: customer 991177 reports AWS Accelerator credits not appearing in Redwood billing UI after they accepted the grant yesterday. They provided the AWS order ARN and a partner confirmation screenshot.
Leo: paste the AWS order ARN + Redwood account id and Ill take a look at entitlement mapping.
Samantha: AWS order ARN: `arn:aws:aws-marketplace::210987654321:subscription/9f8e7d6c5b4a` — Redwood acct `991177`. Partner confirmation: https://files.redwood/workflow/accel-991177-confirm.png
billing-bot: automated check: provider_entitlement_status=ACCEPTED, provider_claim_ts=2026-03-05T14:08:11Z, internal_sync_state=NOT_LINKED
Maria: fyi weve seen a small batch of these where partner used org-level tag that doesn't match the customer's subaccount tag during onboarding. if the providers entitlement is scoped to a different subaccount it stays unlinked.
Samantha: customer says they linked AWS acct `210987654321` during setup, but partner message shows `subaccount: dev-42` while customer uses `subaccount: prod-7`.
Leo: that mismatch would prevent automatic linking. I'm going to attempt a targeted re-link of the entitlement to the prod subaccount and trigger a resync. command: `rbw entitlements relink --provider aws --order arn:aws:... --target-subaccount prod-7 --account 991177 --force`
support-ops: creating manual relink job (job id j-1a2b). will stream logs here.
support-ops: log: relink_step=validate_order -> ok; find_provider_scope=found(org:acct=210987654321, subaccount=dev-42); update_mapping=patch(success)
support-ops: job j-1a2b finished. result: mapped to internal_entitlement e-902, credits_added=250, currency=USD, applied_to_account=991177. ledger_txn=txn_20260305_e902
billing-bot: cache_invalidate=queued for account 991177, ui_refresh ETA ~30s
Samantha: customer verified UI now shows $250 Accelerator credit applied and can consume. forwarded screenshot to partner.
Maria: i'll add a short note to partner-runbook: check partner-subaccount label vs customer-subaccount label during onboarding and prefer explicit subaccount param in the grant flow. also adding a monitoring alert for "entitlement accepted but not linked" spikes.
Leo: nits: we should add a safe rollback id on relink jobs. created an internal ticket INF-7654 to add rollback token in job metadata.
Samantha: thanks all, closing once partner confirms they won't resend identical grant. :thumbsup:
